name: Smart collections
author: Lichtspiel
description: Fills collections in the movie libraries from lists, once a day and on Update now (admins, under Settings): IMDb Top 250, the Oscar winners for Best Picture, TMDB's popular and best rated movies (with a TMDB key), and any public Letterboxd list or watchlist. Only titles you have go in; collections given by hand stay. Settings: lists [{"name": the collection's name, "source": imdb-top-250 | oscar-best-picture | tmdb-popular | tmdb-top-rated | a letterboxd.com address or boxd.it link}], libraries by name (empty = every movie library), tmdb_api_key (only for the TMDB lists).

lists.source.label: TMDB: best rated (needs a TMDB key)
A Letterboxd list or watchlist: its address
